description: This file declares the KernelLogEventsHandler class, which manages kernel log event subscriptions and reporting in a C++ project, specifically within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes methods for adding and removing subscribers, reading kernel log events asynchronously, and delivering events to subscribers.

classes.name: KernelLogEventsHandler
classes.description: A class that handles kernel log event subscriptions, reading log events asynchronously, and notifying subscribers.

methods.name: KernelLogEventsHandler
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the handler with a kernel log file descriptor.

methods.name: AddSubscriber
methods.description: Adds a subscriber callback to receive log events.

methods.name: Unsubscribe
methods.description: Removes a subscriber based on its ID.

methods.name: ReadLoop
methods.description: Private method that runs in a separate thread to read kernel log events.

methods.name: DeliverEvent
methods.description: Private method to deliver a log event to all subscribers.
